winner_summary: Replace BPR with full-catalog masked-item cross-entropy across all four datasets. Padding and the exclusive mask token are excluded from output classes; checkpoint shapes and predictor remain compatible.

Normalize the tied BERT4Rec item table to a fixed Xavier-scale row norm across context lookup, training logits and candidate scoring. Preserve zero padding, the exclusive mask ID and existing checkpoint shapes; the embedded predictor automatically imports the updated implementation.
Narrow BERT4Rec feed-forward layers from 4× to 2× hidden width, retaining one independently trained model per category and compatible predictor construction.
Add position-derived recency input scaling to each category's single BERT4Rec model, automatically shared by the generated predictor.
Replace padded-slot position IDs with chronological nonpadding ranks in all four BERT4Rec category models, automatically shared by the generated predictor.
Add checkpointed training-frequency counts and bounded history-relative input scaling to each category’s single BERT4Rec model, shared automatically with inference.
Add checkpointed training-frequency input scaling to each category’s single BERT4Rec model, shared automatically with generated inference.

Coordinate four changes across all category models: lower learning rate/dropout, temperature-0.8 masked CE, checkpointed training-frequency input scaling, and 0.8-times tied embedding radius. Preserve bidirectional masked training, appended-mask inference, routing and one checkpoint per category.
Increase BERT4Rec feed-forward width from 2× to 3× hidden size for all four independently trained category models; inference uses the updated architecture through its existing model-class import.
Raise only the normalized tied item-embedding radius multiplier to 0.9 for all four category models, consistently in training and prediction.
Reduce only the tied normalized embedding radius multiplier to 0.75 for all four category models, consistently in training and inference.
Reduce only the tied normalized item-embedding radius multiplier from 0.75 to 0.70 for all four datasets.
Increase only the tied normalized item-embedding radius multiplier to 0.775 for all four datasets.
Halve BERT4Rec feed-forward residual contributions in every category model, consistently during training and prediction, without changing checkpoint shapes.
Exempt only the exclusive mask-token embedding from normalization; preserve real-item radius 0.75, tying, frequency modulation, backbone, scoring, loss, optimizer and category routing.
Reduce training-frequency input modulation from 0.04 to 0.02 for each category’s single BERT4Rec model.
Change masked-item cross-entropy temperature from 0.8 to 0.7 for all four BERT4Rec category models.
